name: North Bergen Summer Camp
description_short: Township summer camp for North Bergen residents ages 6 to 12, run at six sites: Horace Mann, Nicholas J. Sacco Jr. High School, Robert Fulton School, Franklin School and the two recreation centers on Meadowview Avenue and Kennedy Boulevard.
notes: North Bergen residents only; registration in person at the Recreation Center, 6300 Meadowview Ave., with a birth certificate, a recent utility bill and $50. Limited to the first 100 children per site. The address shown is the Recreation Center, one of the six sites. Daily hours aren't posted.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Township news post of June 5, 2026: camp runs June 29 through July 31 at six sites, ages 6 to 12, $50, first 100 children per site, North Bergen residents only.
